rationale: The stock is extended 99.6% of the way through its daily range, sitting at the absolute high with zero news catalyst to justify the 18% move from the open. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward profile due to the proximity of the high (limited upside before potential mean reversion) and the high probability of a pullback to the VWAP ($16.47) or 9-EMA ($17.40), while shorting into a strong momentum spike with high relative volume (3.65x) carries significant risk of being stopped out by continued strength.
